additional_info.subject: Fault Report – Corrupted Transactions on Charger  170000466
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support,
We require your assistance in diagnosing a recurring fault identified in one of your charging stations, located at the Delek Sheva HaKokhavim site in Herzliya, Israel.
Please find the relevant details below:
Charger Model:
SichargeDCCS2CCS
Charger Identity Key:
170000466
Connector ID:
1573 (Connector Identity Key = 2)
Location:
Ben Zion Michaeli / Yosef Navo, Herzliya, Israel
First Alert Time:
10/07/2025 12:52:16
Alert Type:
ALERT1018: Corrupt transactions
Number of Events:
13 alerts within a few seconds
Sample Transaction ID:
168603
Technical Description:
The charger reported transactions with invalid or missing meter readings.
System Message: "Wrong power per hour"
Likely Cause: Possible meter hardware issue or firmware malfunction.
We would appreciate your guidance on the following:
Is there a firmware update available for this model?
Are there any diagnostic tools we can use to collect further data from the unit?
Has this issue been observed in other chargers of the same model?
Please find attached relevant logs/screenshots (if applicable).
We kindly request your urgent support according to the 48-hour SLA.
Best regards,
Ziv Vinitzer
Head of DC Charging
*5619
|
+972523927323
ziv@zen-ev.com
Netivei Hayam Blvd. 2 Ashdod

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0440222-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / P4 170000466] Fault Report. CRM:02682000238
additional_info.body:
Dear Ziv Vinitzer,
I hope this message finds you well.
I would like to provide some clarity regarding the invalid session you observed. Upon reviewing the session logs for the timestamp you provided, I found that the IDs were blocked during that time. This blockage is what caused the session to appear invalid on your end.
T
he session was initiated, but due to blocked IDs in the logs, it did not proceed as expected.
This blockage led to the invalid status you encountered. We
understand the inconvenience this may have caused.
If issue persist please let us know.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -Ankita
